mutations.because: renderMotionVariant must spread the run's resolved scene backgrounds onto the compositor's request whenever any were resolved, or a timeline naming per-beat scenes silently renders with none. Forcing the conditional spread's guard to false drops the `backgrounds` key from every compositeVideo request unconditionally, caught by the fixture asserting a two-scene timeline's request carries both resolved keys.

executeVariation must resolve the timeline's scenes once per DISTINCT motion ratio, not once for the whole run — a fixed single ratio would silently cover-fit every scene to the wrong canvas the day a second motion-capable ratio exists (PlatformProfile.vo.ts has exactly one today, but nothing pins that). Forcing the ratio-collection guard to stop after the first ratio ever seen reproduces exactly that bug, caught by the fixture asserting two motion cells at different ratios each receive scene bytes fitted to their own canvas.

rewriteAssetPaths must rewrite copy.timeline.beats[].background exactly like logoPath/inputAsset/audio.path, or a duplicated brief keeps the source brief's scene paths. Forcing the per-beat guard to always short-circuit returns every beat unchanged regardless of whether it names a background, caught by the fixture asserting a duplicated brief's beat background is rewritten to the new brief id.
